problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F=f+ψ over convex Q in a real Hilbert space. The function f is convex and continuously differentiable on the whole space; ψ is convex on Q. A minimizer exists.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective includes a possibly nonsmooth convex term ψ and a convex constraint set Q, accessed together through an exact proximal minimization oracle.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A gradient query at any x returns ∇f(x) exactly, independently of history and oracle seed. No function-value oracle is supplied.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: For every a>0 and z,v, returns an exact minimizer over Q of ‖u−z‖²/(2a)+⟨v,u−z⟩+ψ(u). Gradient and proximal queries share one fixed total call budget.

distinctive_assumptions.label: generalized_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every segment [x,y] on which ‖∇f‖≤M, ‖∇f(x)−∇f(y)‖≤(L0+L1 M)‖x−y‖. Public parameters satisfy L0>0 and L1≥0; no global Lipschitz gradient bound is required.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public x0∈Q and R>0 satisfy ‖x0−x★‖≤R for some composite minimizer with ‖∇f(x★)‖≤G. The parameter G≥0 is hidden from the algorithm, although the budget depends on it. No initial objective-gap bound or bounded feasible set is assumed. The ambient real Hilbert space may be infinite-dimensional.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: For ε>0, the output satisfies F(output)−F(x★)≤ε relative to a minimizer x★∈Q.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point must belong to Q.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Convex composite optimization with gradient-dependent smoothness, a radius-only initialization guarantee, and a hidden gradient bound at a composite minimizer is a meaningful variant of the classical globally smooth formulation.
